blocks.tamil_translation: sixth, the canal he made; seventh, the charity he gave during his lifetime in a state of health so that rewards would reach him even after death; these bring rewards to a Mu'min even after he dies,” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسٍ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا تَكَلَّمَ بِكَلِمَةٍ أَعَادَهَا ثَلَاثاً حَتَّي تُفْهَمَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (الحديث) رواه البخاري باب من اعاد الحديث ...رقم:٩٥
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Anas (RA) narrates, “Rasulullah ﷺ would repeat a word three times so that it would be understood.”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- When Rasulullah ﷺ said something important, he would say it three times so that people would understand. Likewise, when the crowd of people was large, he would turn to three directions and say it three times so that people could understand the speech easily.
(Mazahir-e-Haq)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ ﵄ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: إِنَّ اللهَ لَا يَقْبِضُ الْعِلْمَ إِنْتِزَاعاً يَنْتَزِعُهُ مِنَ الْعِبَادِ وَلكِنْ يَقْبِضُ الْعِلْمَ بِقَبْضِ الْعُلَمَاءِ حَتَّي إِذَا لَمْ يَبْقَ عَالِمٌ إِتَّخَذَ النَّاسُ رُؤُوساً جُهَّالاً فَسُئِلُوا فَأَفْتَوْا بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ فَضَلُّوا وَأَضَلُّوا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب كيف يقبض العلم؟ رقم:١٠٠
blocks.tamil_translation: “Near the Day of Final Judgement, Allah will not take away knowledge and wisdom from the hearts of people all at once. Allah will cause the Ulama to die one after another. Finally, not even a single Alim will remain alive. Then people will take the ignorant as their leaders instead of the Ulama. To them,
